notes.LEMMA R1: A[w] is a UFD: Nagata's criterion: A[w] is a Noetherian domain, x is prime in it (R1b), and A[w]_x = C[x^{+-1},z,t][w] is a UFD (R1a). Hence A[w] is a UFD, which is what the gcd/content argument of the content proposition needs.
notes.LEMMA R4: pi is a smooth morphism: The relative differential of W over A^2_{t,q} in the fibre coordinates (p, Z, H) is (-1-2p, -q, t^3), which vanishes only at p = -1/2, q = t = 0; there W = 1/4, so the locus misses Y_1 = V(W) entirely. Hence pi is smooth of relative dimension 2, and in particular flat. Smooth is the hypothesis the Gysin map and the Borel-Moore localisation sequence of the final section actually require.
notes.R1a P is degree 1 in y with leading coe: so A_x = C[x^{+-1}, z, t], a localised polynomial ring
notes.R1a hence A_x is a UFD (localisation of: C[x^{+-1}, z, t] = C[x,z,t] localised at the prime x
notes.R1b H15 boundary: z^2 - t^2 IS reducibl: the irreducibility test is not vacuous
notes.R1b z^2 + t^3 is irreducible over Q: so C[y,z,t,w]/(z^2+t^3) is a domain and x is prime in A[w]
notes.R2 linear parts at the crossing point: rank of the linear parts = 0; 4 of the 4 generators have zero linear part
notes.R2 scope: ONE bounded attempt authorised (A33 R2). The candidate point is the crossing point of the two components, (p,q,t,Z) = (-1,0,0,0), which lies on both minimal primes.
notes.R2 verdict: The bounded attempt does NOT land. The linear-part rank is 0, so it gives the trivial bound mu >= 1, which does not exceed the codimension 2 and therefore certifies nothing. A real certificate needs mu(I_m) computed in the local ring, which is outside the exact symbolic machinery here. Per A33 R2 the complete-intersection sentence is DELETED from the paper; the rectification obstruction (the singular component) is untouched and survives without it.

notes.R4 W = 1/4 there, so no such point lies: W == 1/4 identically on the degeneracy locus, Z and H free

R1_factoriality.R1a: A_x = C[x^{+-1}, z, t]; P is degree 1 in y with unit coefficient x^2 after inverting x
R1_factoriality.R1b: A[w]/(x) = C[y,z,t,w]/(z^2+t^3), a domain since z^2+t^3 is irreducible
R1_factoriality.conclusion: A[w] is factorial; the content of a derivation is therefore well defined
R1_factoriality.criterion: Nagata: R Noetherian domain, f prime, R_f a UFD => R a UFD

R2_complete_intersection.action: the complete-intersection sentence is deleted from the paper; the rectification obstruction does not depend on it
R2_complete_intersection.outcome: DOES NOT LAND -- the linear-part bound does not exceed the codimension

R4_smoothness.conclusion: pi is smooth of relative dimension 2, hence flat; this replaces the bare flatness appeal
R4_smoothness.relative_differential: (-1-2p, -q, t^3) in the fibre coordinates (p, Z, H)
R4_smoothness.value_of_W_there: 1/4, so the locus is disjoint from Y_1
